prBodyNotes: - Released at least seven days ago, unless it fixes a security vulnerability, or is a PostgreSQL minor release or image digest, which arrive at once.

customManagers.description: Container images pinned by digest in scripts

packageRules.description: PostgreSQL's minor releases, such as 18.6 to 18.7, and image digest updates carry security fixes from the official publisher, so they are opened first and never wait behind the limits on open pull requests. Docker Hub's dates change on every routine rebuild, so the seven-day minimum release age would hold these fixes back; major releases and other images keep it.

Minor and patch updates of npm packages arrive together each week in one pull request, so the queue stays short. Major updates, container images, and the Node.js and pnpm versions that package.json names keep a pull request each, so Node.js moves with its other pins. Security fixes are never grouped, and arrive at once.
